methods.label: Use the definition of distance
methods.explanation: The distance from a point to a line is the length of the perpendicular segment, namely \(AD=5\) cm. (\(AB\) is an oblique segment and is longer than the perpendicular segment.)
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 7 definition of point-to-line distance.
